title: Owned DuckDB ceilings: 10M bounded re-measure under three ceilings

workload.fixture: csv_10000000_std (retained M7-T2a fixture, reused not regenerated)

reference_ladder.source: TESTING §4.3.3 (M7-T2a, before the ceiling helper existed)

honest_notes: The 4 GiB default and 1 GiB floor both run above the 10M working set, so their RSS difference vs the unbounded 677.0 MB (-0.3% / -6.7%) is variance, not an improvement.
Only the 256 MB pass spills because only it sits below the working set; it is also the fastest because 28 metrics became ERROR instead of computing.
spill_peak_kb for the shipped-default pass is null: that pass ran before the sampler existed. Its 4 GiB ceiling is above the working set, so a spill was not expected.
Spill is sampled from the scratch dir every 5 s; duckdb_memory() reports live buffers only and reads 0 once a query completes.
